title: Portuguese-Style Lamb Stew
description: A hearty, gluten-free stew made with tender lamb and vibrant vegetables.
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
2. Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
3. Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
4. Add the sliced onions to the pot and cook until they're softened and caramelized, about 8 minutes.
5. Add the sliced bell peppers to the pot and cook until they're tender, about 5 minutes.
6. Add the stew tomatoes, Portuguese-Style seasoning, red wine, and gluten-free broth to the pot.
7. Return the lamb to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
8. Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
9. Braise the stew in the preheated oven at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
10. Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
11. Stir in the fresh cilantro and season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
12. Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
